# Honkbal Hoofdklasse

> The fan website for the KNBSB Honkbal Hoofdklasse — the top professional baseball league in the Netherlands.

## What this site covers

- Live scores, boxscores and standings for all Honkbal Hoofdklasse games
- Season 2026 batting and pitching statistics for all players
- League leaders per statistical category
- Player profiles with career stats
- Team rosters for all 7 clubs: Curaçao Neptunus, Amsterdam Pirates, Kinheim, HCAW, Oosterhout Twins, Hoofddorp Pioniers and UVV
- Daily baseball trivia games: Pickle (Thu & Sat) and Immaculate Grid (Fri)
- Game schedule and upcoming fixtures
- Awards and honours per season

## Teams

- Curaçao Neptunus (Rotterdam)
- Amsterdam Pirates
- Kinheim (Haarlem)
- HCAW (Bussum)
- Oosterhout Twins
- Hoofddorp Pioniers
- UVV (Utrecht)

## Data sources

Statistics are sourced from the KNBSB stats system (stats.knbsbstats.nl).
Live scores are updated every 60 seconds during games.
